{{Top|leg}}
'''Signal officer''' was a position held in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] was the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']]{{'s}} signal officer during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth campaign]] of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
